text:
Asha (product): Thinking about a lightweight UX for automatic fallback policies — idea: a 'monitor-only' preview mode you can enable per-rollout so we sample decisions but don't actually route. Want quick feedback before flipping auto-apply.
Liam (eng): +1. we need to show sampled traces though, otherwise it's just numbers. tiny UX: live stream of 1 request every 10s that hit the policy.
Priya (devex): We should surface why a request would fail over — not just 'fallback triggered'. maybe a compact reason card: trigger condition + last 3 signal values.
Marco (sre): Agree. Also add an option to throttle the fallback ramp (like 5% => 20% => 100%) so we can watch error impact.
Asha (product): Exactly — three knobs: monitor-only toggle, ramp slider, and a 'safety cutover' threshold (e.g., 5% latency p90 breach). UI copy to be short.
Liam (eng): Implementation Q: should the policy engine return a decision tuple {decision, trace_id, signals} in the API so the console can show it? or do we emit separate telemetry events?
Priya (devex): Prefer inline tuple so SDKs can attach it to the request (makes repro easier). But also emit sampled telemetry to the observability pipeline.
Marco (sre): Warning: inline tuples increase payload size. We should sample full signal dumps and store small decision metadata for every request. audit-bot can link them.
Zoe (privacy): Heads up: sampled payloads might contain PII depending on prompts. We need redaction rules and KMS tagging before storing. retention policy must be in the rollout modal.
Asha (product): Good point. UX needs a short privacy note: "Sampled requests are redacted and retained 30 days by default" with a link to policy. Option to disable sampling per-account.
Liam (eng): For audit: include a per-decision event id and a replay link that opens the playbook simulator. Maybe: decision_id -> opens console with simulated inputs.
Priya (devex): UX mock idea: small badge next to rollout state: [monitoring • 12 sampled] clickable -> list of decision rows. Each row: time, trigger, decision_id, mini-preview of signals.
Marco (sre): Ops-safety: add an escape hatch button that immediately pauses auto-apply and forces 100% fallback to a safe model. Should be on every rollout page.
Asha (product): Behavior for errors: classify triggers as hard (instant fallback) vs soft (gradual). UX needs to let people tag them. e.g. "error_rate (hard)" vs "latency_p90 (soft)" 
Liam (eng): Internally we should expose a small DSL: `when error_rate>5% then immediate_fallback else ramp_down(10%)` — console translates this to toggles.
Priya (devex): Also include a simulated-phases preview: graph showing expected traffic split over time if policy runs. Useful for customer support.
Zoe (privacy): Also require a checkbox for org admins to allow sampling at org level (legal signoff). show which orgs have sampling enabled.
Marco (sre): Telemetry note: tag all decision events with rollout_id, policy_hash, and node_region. helps debug noisy regions.
Liam (eng): One API debate: should policy evaluation be synchronous in the request path (adds latency) or async with last-decision cache? We talked earlier but we need a UX constraint: if you choose 'hard immediate' triggers, we must eval sync. Mention that in UI.
Asha (product): Action items: 1) Devex to mock monitor-only panel (Priya) 2) Eng to spec decision tuple + sampling plan (Liam) 3) SRE to propose escape-hatch flow + ramp defaults (Marco) 4) Privacy to draft redaction + retention copy (Zoe).
Priya (devex): I'll put a quick figma by EOD and include a compact decision row pattern.
Liam (eng): I'll write up the API shapes and a perf note for sync vs cached evals.
Marco (sre): I'll prototype a single-click pause endpoint and a beta-safe-model mapping.
Zoe (privacy): Drafting redaction rules now. flag me in PR for the wording.
ops-bot: note: new task created INC-4872 "monitor-only fallback UX mocks" assigned to Priya.
audit-bot: sample retention default=30d, PII-redaction=enabled, policy=org_required_consent.
Asha (product): Thanks all — sync at 3pm if anyone wants to go over the mock and API sketch. @Liam @Priya @Marco @Zoe :thumbsup:
Liam (eng): :thumbsup:
Priya (devex): :heart:
Marco (sre): I'll be there.
Zoe (privacy): I'll join for the privacy copy review."
